title: Time Restricted Eating for WeIght LoSs MainTenance-2
official: Time Restricted Eating for WeIght LoSs MainTenance-2 (TWIST-2): A Single-site, 2-arm Randomized Clinical Trial in Adults With Recent Weight Loss
summary: The TWIST 2.0 Study is a 12-month, 2-arm RCT in adults with recent weight loss. We will examine the efficacy of TRE on weight (Aim 1a) and fat mass (Aim 1b) regain, and describe changes in subjective appetite following a mixed-meal tolerance test (Exploratory).
